item.title: The history of WordPress
item.description: WordPress is a free, open-source content management system (CMS) that was first released in 2003 by founders Matt Mullenweg and Mike Little. Since then, it has become one of the most popular CMSs in the world, powering over 40% of all websites on the internet. The post The history of WordPress first appeared on ROI Designs.

item.title: WordPress market share 2025
item.description: It powers 39.7% of the internet! Between 2011 and 2019, WordPress established itself as the CMS and by the beginning of 2020, over one in three websites were using it. So who is the competition? Coming in second place on the market share league table is Shopify, powering an estimated 3% of all websites. The post WordPress market share 2025 first appeared on ROI Designs.
